'''Ugnaught wine''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage.

==History==
A supply of this [[Wine/Legends|wine]] was stored in the cellar of a hidden base in the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] hired a group of individuals as security for the base and gave them access to the wine cellar and the Ugnaught wine contained within.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]''
